title: spec-kit: full SDD, planning before code
input: Shadow bundle for a clear spec contribution with method: spec-kit; no spec-quality flags; repo conventions present.
pass_criteria: Agent follows the full SDD phases and writes NO implementation code before the specification, plan and tasks are produced and reviewed: constitution (once per repo), specify seeded from our spec + acceptance criteria, plan grounded in conventions + constitution, dependency-ordered tasks, then TDD red-green implement, sabotage-test, converge until Converged; reviews each phase with the human; maps tasks.md->context/tasks/, plan/spec->context/documents/, constitution->repo notes, then ctx init; SHADOW = zero remote writes; honest CI; run logged with --prompt-version v2.
